procnotices.notice_text:
Phnom Penh, 17 August 2026

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST

Individual Consultant: National Senior Technical Advisor (Intermittent) (MISTI-IC-13)

 

Project Title: WATER SUPPLY AND SANITATION ACCELERATION PROJECT (WASAC)

IDA Credit No.: 7427-KH and 7428-KH Project ID No.: P178417

Contract No. and Title: MISTI-IC-13, National Senior Technical Advisor (Intermittent)

 

  1. The Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology & Innovation (MISTI) and the Ministry of Public Works and Transportation (MPWT), through the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) on behalf of the Royal Government of Cambodia (RGC), have received a Credit in the amount of US$163 million equivalent from the International Development Association (IDA) toward the cost of the Water Supply and Sanitation Acceleration Project (WASAC) for six years starting from 2024 to 2029 and intends to apply part of the proceeds for Consulting Service - Individual Consultant: National Senior Technical Advisor (Intermittent) (MISTI-IC-13).
  2. The WASAC now invites expressions of interest from qualified and experienced Individual National Consultants for National Senior Technical Advisor (Intermittent) (MISTI-IC-13), for which the detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) can be found at: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1yjlYkI0DVj1hkh5lesXfffthYQ2S0UMa?usp=sharing or can be obtained at the address given below. A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Individual Consultant Selection method set out in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, Procurement in Investment Project Financing, Fifth Edition, dated September 2023, and Government SOP (December 2019).
  3. In submitting their expressions of interest, national consultants are kindly requested to indicate the following reference National Senior Technical Advisor (Intermittent) (MISTI-IC-13) and provide with their updated Curriculum Vitae with recent photo, indicating personal and technical skills, education qualifications, experience in similar assignments, along with the names of three (3) referees with contact information (e-mail address and telephone numbers).
  4. The duration of the contract is: an initial 132 days over the first 12 months (intermittent), with possible extensions for the second and third years (up to a total of 396 days) based on the consultant’s performance and project requirements.
  5. Further information in a written form can be obtained at the address below during office hours from 8:00AM to 5:00PM, Monday to Friday, except public holidays, at the General Department of Potable Water, Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology & Innovation, No. 45, Preah Norodom Blvd., Phnom Penh, Cambodia. H.E. Tan Sokchea, Director General of General Department of Potable Water, MISTI/WASAC Project Manager, Email: tan.sokchea@gmail.com; Cc: Houl Bonnarith, Under Secretary of State, MISTI/WASAC Project Director, Email:  bonnarith6888@gmail.com, and Mr. Kim Chanrithy, Procurement Officer, Email: kimchanrithy2023@gmail.com.
  6. Expressions of Interest may be submitted in electronic copy followed by the submission of a hard copy if possible and must be submitted to the address below on or before 1 September 2026 (before 5:00 P.M., Phnom Penh Time). Only short-listed candidates will be invited for contract negotiations.

Attn: H.E. Tan Sokchea, Director General of General Department of Potable Water/WASAC Project Manager, Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology & Innovation (MISTI), No. 45, Preah Norodom Blvd., Phnom Penh, Cambodia. Email: tan.sokchea@gmail.com; Cc: Houl Bonnarith, Under Secretary of State, MISTI/WASAC Project Director, Email:  bonnarith6888@gmail.com, and Mr. Kim Chanrithy, Procurement Officer, Email: kimchanrithy2023@gmail.com.

For. Minister

Under Secretary of State

Houl Bonnarith

procnotices.notice_text:
Name of Project 

Clean Energy and Power Trade Development in Southeast Asia Project of the Multi Phase Programmatic Approach Accelerating Sustainable Energy Transition (MPA ASET) 

Loan No/Credit No/ Grand Number 

P181555 / IDA -E3430 

Assignment Title 

APG Feasibility Study Phase-2 of Cambodia – Lao PDR Cross-border Interconnection

Procurement Plan Reference Number 

ID-ACE-559462-CS-QBS 

Country of Delivery  

ASEAN 

The ASEAN Centre for Energy has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Clean Energy and Power Trade Development in Southeast Asia Project of the Multi-Phase Programmatic Approach Accelerating Sustainable Energy Transition/MPA ASET (P181555) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for Consulting Firm to develop APG Feasibility Study Phase-2 of Cambodia – Lao PDR Cross-border Interconnection.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include the Provision of the ASEAN Power Grid (APG) Feasibility Study Phase-2 of Cambodia – Lao PDR Cross-border Interconnection. The assignment is expected to run for over a period of eighteen (18) months commencing from tentatively 1 November 2026 and ending on 2 May 2028. Actual commencement date will be communicated with the consulting firm that is successfully selected from the procurement process.

The ASEAN Centre for Energy now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

Interested Consultants must submit detailed documentary evidence indicating credentials to perform the services including company profiles, core business description, description of similar assignments and experience in similar conditions, qualifications relevant to this field, brochure (if available) and other relevant information.

Consultants will be shortlisted based on, including but not limited to the following criteria:

Mandatory requirements:

  • Experience in undertaking strategic planning, technical studies, or advisory services related to electricity transmission systems, regional power markets, or cross-border power interconnections for governments, utilities, regional organizations, or international development partners.
  • Successful completion, within the last ten (10) years, of assignments similar in nature, scope, organizational capability and complexity, including one or more of the following:
    • Feasibility studies for cross-border electricity interconnections;
    • Transmission planning and power system expansion studies;
    • Studies related to regional power system integration and cross-border electricity trade.
    • Environmental Social Impact Assessment study for transmission line

Desirable requirements:

  • Experience working in ASEAN Member States or on regional power integration initiatives with understanding of institutional, regulatory and operational contexts of ASEAN power sector.

Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage. Hence, CVs are not required at this stage.

The Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment are attached to this request for expressions of interest or can be found at the following website: https://go.aseanenergy.org/FS-Phase-2-Cambodia-LaoPDR. The Terms of Reference are subjected to final revision in subsequent stage of the procurement process, which will be informed in due time to successfully shortlisted Consultants.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” July 2016, revised in sixth edition dated February 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Firms may associate with others to strengthen their qualifications, clearly indicating whether the association is a Joint Venture (JV) and/or Sub-Consultancy. If the association is a JV, the EOI must include a Letter of Intent to form the JV and identify the Lead Firm. For shortlisting, the qualifications of all JV members will be assessed jointly, while the qualifications of any Sub-Consultant will not be considered.

The Consulting firm will be selected in accordance with the Quality Based Selection method. The Full Technical Proposal (FTP) format will be applied in evaluating the proposals as specified in procedures set out in the last updated version of World Bank Guidelines

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours, 09:00 to 17:00 Jakarta Time (GMT+7).

Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form by e-mail at the latest by 14 August 2026, 23:59 (GMT+7) to:

ASEAN CENTRE FOR ENERGY

Attn: MPA ASET PMU

E-mail: asetprocurement@aseanenergy.org

Subject: [EOI Submission] APG Feasibility Study Phase-2 of Cambodia – Lao PDR Cross-border Interconnection (ID-ACE-559462-CS-QBS) – [Insert Name of Firm]
